start: Gym is online, no timings saved yet; Settings, button to Gym timings

steps.action: Open Gym timings
user_sees: Title 'Gym timings'
'When your gym is open, for members to see'
Card 'Start from' with 'Pick the one closest to your gym, then change any day.'
must_not: A blank page or an endless 'Loading…'
The read-only card 'Only the owner can change the gym timings.' shown to the owner

steps.action: Tap a starting point (morning and evening)
user_sees: 'Right now members see: …' line
Section 'Every week' with Monday to Sunday, each with Closed / Times / 24 hours
Button 'Save and show members'
must_not: Anything saved before Save is tapped
A day with no times and no 'Closed' word

steps.action: Change Monday's times, tap 'Copy Monday to Tue to Sat', set Sunday to 'Closed'
user_sees: Tuesday to Saturday show Monday's times
Sunday shows Closed
The 'Right now members see' line follows the change
must_not: Sunday overwritten by the copy
The preview line still showing the old times

steps.action: Tap 'Save and show members'
user_sees: Button reads 'Saving…', then 'Saved ✓'
Toast 'Gym timings saved. Members see them in the MettleUp app (Gym tab) within 10 minutes.'
'These timings are saved (…) and members see them. Change any time above to save again.'
must_not: The toast shown when the server refused the save
Two saves from a double tap
Times stored in a zone other than India time

start: More menu, row 'Gym timings' ('When you are open, for members to see'); timings already saved; other kind: a special day

steps.action: Tap the 'Gym timings' row in More
user_sees: The editor with the saved week
'Last saved <date> by <name>.'
Greyed button 'Saved ✓'
must_not: The 'Start from' card when timings exist
Another branch's timings

steps.action: Tap '+ Add a special day', pick a date, type 'Diwali' in 'why (optional)', leave it 'Closed'
user_sees: A new block 'Special day 1: date' set to tomorrow by default
'Add holidays like Diwali, or days with other times. Members see them on the Gym tab 7 days before.'
Button turns to 'Save timings'
must_not: A special day dated in the past accepted with no word
A 31st special day (the add button is off at 30)

steps.action: Type 'Ladies batch 11 am to 12 pm' in 'One line members see under the timings', tap 'Save timings'
user_sees: Toast 'Gym timings saved. Members see them in the MettleUp app (Gym tab) within 10 minutes.'
Button back to 'Saved ✓'
must_not: The weekly times changed by saving a special day
The note cut short without a word

start: Gym timings editor open; and the same page when the gym is not online

steps.action: Set Monday to 'Times', clear the closing time (or make the evening time overlap the morning one), tap Save
user_sees: A red line with the problem in plain words
'Fix the times below to see what members will see.' in place of the preview
Nothing sent to the server
must_not: A save with a broken time
The toast 'Gym timings saved…'
Members seeing half-set times

steps.action: Fix the time, turn the internet off, tap 'Save timings'
user_sees: The save button waits for the internet, or a red line says the save did not go through
The typed times are still on the page
must_not: A 'saved' message for a save that failed
The draft thrown away

steps.action: Open Gym timings on a gym that is not online (offline-only sign-in)
user_sees: 'Gym timings need your gym online'
'Members’ phones read the timings from your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An editor that looks as if it saves
A crash or a blank page

steps.action: Open Gym timings on a server without the timings function
user_sees: 'Gym timings are not switched on for your gym yet'
'They will appear here once your gym’s server has them.'
must_not: A raw server error text
An endless 'Loading…'

start: Timings saved and seen by members

steps.action: Change one closing time
user_sees: Button turns from 'Saved ✓' to 'Save timings'
The 'These timings are saved…' line goes away
must_not: Members seeing the new time before Save

steps.action: Put the time back to what it was
user_sees: Button returns to 'Saved ✓' (greyed)
'These timings are saved (…) and members see them. Change any time above to save again.'
must_not: A save button left active with nothing changed

steps.action: Tap 'Remove timings'
user_sees: Sheet 'Remove the gym timings?'
'Members will no longer see when your gym is open. You can add the timings again at any time.'
Buttons 'Keep them' and 'Remove'
must_not: Timings removed before 'Remove' is tapped

steps.action: Tap 'Keep them', then 'Remove timings' again and 'Remove'
user_sees: After 'Keep them': the editor unchanged
After 'Remove': the 'Start from' card and toast 'Gym timings removed. Members no longer see them.'
must_not: Members still shown 'Open now' after removal (beyond the phone's refresh time)
The Get started tick lost or a crash on the empty state

steps.action: Pick a starting point again and tap 'Save and show members'
user_sees: Toast 'Gym timings saved…'
'Last saved <today> by <name>.'
must_not: Old special days or the old note coming back by themselves

start: Gym with two branches; owner signed in

steps.action: Open Gym timings in branch A
user_sees: Subtitle 'When <branch A> is open. Each branch has its own timings.'
'Members see these on the Gym tab of the MettleUp app: “Open now · closes 10:00 pm”, and the whole week. Times are India time.'
must_not: Branch B's timings shown or changed
Another gym's timings

steps.action: Save, then look at 'Last saved'
user_sees: 'Last saved <date> by <owner name>.'
must_not: A staff person's phone number or any member detail on this page

steps.action: Sign in as front desk and try to save through the page
user_sees: Read-only card; 'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'
must_not: A front-desk session able to change timings (the server answers OWNER_ONLY)

start: Front desk signed in, gym online, owner has saved timings; More menu row 'Gym timings' ('When the gym is open')

steps.action: Tap 'Gym timings'
user_sees: Title 'Gym timings'
Card 'Your gym’s timings'
'Right now members see: <Open now · closes …>'
must_not: The editor with Save or 'Remove timings' buttons
An endless 'Loading…'

steps.action: Read the week and the special days to a member on the phone
user_sees: Day groups with their times (for example 'Mon to Sat' and the times)
Coming special days as a list
The owner's note under them
'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'
must_not: Special days already past still listed
Times different from what the member app shows

steps.action: Tap 'Back to Settings'
user_sees: The Settings page
must_not: A sign-out or a blank page

start: Front desk signed in; wants to change a time

steps.action: Open Gym timings and look for a way to edit
user_sees: Read-only card only
'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'
must_not: Any time box, Save or Remove button
A change that reaches the server (it answers OWNER_ONLY)

steps.action: Open the page when the gym is not online
user_sees: 'Gym timings need your gym online' with the line about Settings → Sign-in & data
must_not: Old timings shown as if they were current

steps.action: Open the page with the internet off
user_sees: A red line with the reason and the button 'Try again'
must_not: A blank card with no way to retry

start: Front desk signed in; owner has not saved timings, then saves, then removes them

steps.action: Open Gym timings before the owner has saved any
user_sees: Card 'Your gym’s timings'
'No timings yet.'
'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'
must_not: A made-up default week
'Right now members see: Closed'

steps.action: Owner saves timings; front desk opens the page again
user_sees: 'Right now members see: …' and the week
must_not: Still 'No timings yet.' after reopening the page

steps.action: Owner removes the timings; front desk opens the page again
user_sees: 'No timings yet.'
must_not: The removed times still shown
